teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: menu, starter, main course, dessert, table, waiter, dish, recommend, delicious, bill

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
menu, starter, main course, dessert, table, waiter, dish, recommend, delicious, bill
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• A table for two, please (requesting table)
• What is the dish of the day? (asking special)
• For main course, I will have the fish (ordering main course)
• It was delicious, thank you (praising meal)
Pronunciation Focus:
Stress in 'recommend' /ˌrek.əˈmend/ and 'delicious' /dɪˈlɪʃ.əs/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Ordering Phrases & Questions ('What do you recommend?', 'I will have the chicken')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Ordering Phrases & Questions ('What do you recommend?', 'I will have the chicken')
Controlled Practice:
Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal. What is it called?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Welcome! Here is the menu. What would you like for starters?
B: I will have the tomato soup, please.
A: And for the main course?
B: I will have the grilled chicken with salad.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to a restaurant waiter taking orders from a couple and note their starter, main, and dessert choices.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can read a menu, ask about dishes, and order a full meal at a restaurant.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can read a menu, ask about dishes, and order a full meal at a restaurant.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
